correctness.rationale: The polar form of Q_H is adjacency over F2. Its Gauss sum equals −16 precisely in the eight-dimensional nonsingular elliptic case; degenerate forms give zero or magnitude ≥32. Independent Walsh–Hadamard transform on all 2^12 spanning-edge subsets for six representative cubic graphs reproduced elliptic counts (54,26,17,6,0,5), so only classes 2 and 5 have odd Möbius transforms. The source has a separate full labeled enumeration and orbit-partition certificate for all 19355 cubic graphs, with six orbit sizes (35,2520,10080,3360,840,2520); the audited code was inspected and its saturation/orbit argument reconstructed. This is finite exhaustive classification, not a claim about all graphs.
